mac.key: ["running","Mac ↔ apollo, mars's box on Linux (direct 10 GbE, X540)","RW3-noop-many-apollo"]
mac.text: The Mac, a MacBook Pro with an M1 Max, is linked by wired 10 GbE to apollo, a Linux machine belonging to mars. The lab is comparing rsync with two xs file-transfer tools when moving many small files, to see whether rsync is at least 5% faster to durable storage in some setting.

mars.text: This pair links neo, a Raspberry Pi 5 with 4 GB of memory and an NVMe drive, to mars, a 12-core Ryzen 9 desktop with 32 GB of memory, over a wired gigabit connection. It is idle right now, with no experiment running.

neo.text: The pair neo and vpsb is joined by a wired link. No runner is active and no experiment is set up, so this pair is idle.

neo-ssd.text: neo, a Raspberry Pi 5 with 4 GB of memory and an NVMe drive, is linked to its partner over a local SSD connection. Paused, it asks whether capping neo at 2 CPUs widens xs -a -j4's deficit to rsync -a on cold local copies of real-psample.
